reforms.name: Republic of the Federation of Bavia

E162.title: We will not fall!
E162.description1: Since the outbreak of the two-front war on our capital, attacks have intensified in the central area where Fengong lived. Today, it was declared that he was killed. Our country is left without a president in such difficult times. We simply won't be able to hold elections now. Something will have to be done, but what...?

E161.title: Fine.
E161.description1: Very unexpectedly, Ordenstein mobilized all its forces and decided to invade us. Not only did we not expect such a blow, but Metenia, with whom we had been establishing ties, decided to betray us. Now our task is to weather this storm and try to stay alive! Forward, for the sake of the nation!

E78.title: Inspire!
E78.description1: We have reclaimed most of our lands, now they are finally back underground, and our country can breathe a sigh of relief.

E159.title: Fine.
E159.description1: After lengthy negotiations in Galsk, we managed to agree to completely end the blockade, which was preventing us from trading with the rest of the world. We also began discussing the possibility of joining the Communist Party of the Soviet Union, which would allow us to have all reparations waived. We also agreed that we can now keep our ships in the ports of Galsk!

E158.title: Fine
E158.description1: After positive progress abroad, it's time for us to consider our internal structure. The Valterians live within our country. They were annexed during the uprising against Endersk. The issue with them has remained unresolved since then. One of the best options is to integrate them into our nationality; they will retain all their cultural values, but will also be strongly integrated.

E155.title: Good.
E155.description1: Since the country's reform in 1817, elections to the Republic have been held in July every five years. Finally, after many years of dictatorship, Emneron died, restoring democracy. The elections featured candidates from the CPM, SRM, and DPM. After six months of preparation, the DPM candidate won. He is a supporter of reforms and the restoration of democracy. He plans to reconcile relations with Metania and begin developing trade with Gali and Barborossia.

E154.title: It's clear.
E154.description1: In the north, Endersk is preventing us from creating a proper army. Besides reparations, we're limited to a force of no more than 100,000 men, which could seriously undermine our chances of survival. Besides this, the world has been hit by a major crisis, and as a country deeply integrated into global trade, we've felt it deeply. But elections are coming soon, and we'll finally be able to change our course.

E252.title: OK
E252.description1: Here you can change the laws in your country. For example, increase the military budget or how your economy will work. Your choices will affect many factors for your country. Click on one of the answers if you want to change anything there. Don't worry, the answers themselves won't be selected. (You'll need Prestige to accept them.)

E250.title: New lands!
E250.description1: The Republic of Lindonia was created by Endersk to support his ambitions in Bavia, but after a long time, it became clear that not only were they holding their positions poorly, but they were also struggling to free themselves. So, recently, when Batvian troops entered the region, Endersk simply decided to seize some land for himself...

E249.title: It's clear.
E249.description1: Ordenstein decided to invade further into Gondricia while it was in civil war, we don't know their plans, but they seem to be psychopaths.

E248.title: God...
E248.description1: After a crushing defeat, Metta was divided, creating Valtheria. Now, the governments of these states have agreed to unification. Now the two divided nations are united, and Ordenstein has refused to comment on this development.

E244.title: I'm buying.
E244.description1: Military corporations have sent us a proposal to purchase additional fleets for our Navy. Will we buy them?

E247.title: OK
E247.description1: Recently, the Metta government reported that troops from Mettenberg and Metania had entered their territory without declaring war. Mettenberg, as usual, decided to remain silent, and Metania explained her zeal. They wanted to seize important ports for trade and to link up with the PKBP. Although Metania has ties to the Ordenstein, they decided not to speak of it.

E246.title: OK
E246.description1: We have been subjected to a huge number of sanctions, and we have to survive with them...

E242.title: I'm buying.
E242.description1: The military corporations sent us an offer to purchase 5 artillery pieces. Will we buy them?

E001.title: Bot Diplomacy.
E001.description: Will you play with bot diplomacy settings enabled or not?
E001.description1: It will be historical and there will be no problems.
E001.description2: There may be major problems with history.

E241.title: I'm buying.
E241.description1: The military corporations sent us an offer to purchase 10 tanks and 5 artillery pieces. Will we buy them?

E240.title: Hooray!
E240.description1: Military corporations sent us an offer to purchase 10 tanks. Will we buy them?

E239.title: I'm buying.
E239.description1: Military corporations sent us an offer to purchase 5 tanks. Will we buy them?

E238.title: OK.
E238.description1: Military corporations sent us an offer to purchase three tanks. Will we buy them?

E237.title: OK.
E237.description1: WE are a huge country, it is very difficult for us to maintain land management at a good level.

E236.title: OK.
E236.description1: We are a large country, we already have some problems with the organization of our lands.

E234.title: OK.
E234.description1: We are a small country, it is easy for us to deal with all our problems regarding the administration, but there are already some minor issues.

E235.title: OK.
E235.description1: We are an average country, it is quite easy for us to cope with problems.

E233.title: Yes
E233.description1: We are a very small country, it is easy for us to deal with all our problems regarding the administration.

E232.title: Let's make a strong impact. (+3 influence points)

E231.title: Yes
E231.answer2: Got it (Let's not waste money on influence now)
E231.description1: The struggle for influence over the ruler of the future, united country has begun. Both countries, the Blue Column and the Free Army, start with the same influence level (0). The goal is to reach 10 influence. Unfortunately, we haven't yet implemented a special counter to track your influence, so you'll have to calculate it yourself. (THIS IS CURRENTLY IN BETA DUE TO WAITING FOR THE DEVELOPER TO ADD THE REQUIRED TEAM, SO PLEASE JUST BUY THE ONE YOU SHOULD HAVE MECHANICALLY RECEIVED.)

E65.title: You are welcome!
E65.description1: It's time for us to take Batvia and move on to uniting the lands. Forward!

E48.title: Hooray!
E48.description1: We've decided to ally with the Kingdom of Bavia, eschewing the war with the ASR. The ASR captured part of the Kingdom's lands last summer, so why should we strengthen the enemy? We may not recognize anyone, but for the sake of the League's future, it's time for us to do so.

E229.title: It's time to fight now!
E229.description1: Finally, the Blue Column has begun moving toward unification. We need to push out all enemy influence and take over the government of the new country. We both share similar views, we both want to establish a democracy, but the Column is too peaceful for this world...

E227.title: Fine.
E227.description1: Apart from Bagora, our country doesn't have any good centers of industrialization, so we decided to partially develop the countryside, improve roads, hospitals, and so on. But this could require a considerable amount of development funds.

E215.title: So we wait.
E215.description1: Finally, things have calmed down. We can tell you our plan. Blue column – we have a plan. We're tired of these endless changes of government and leaders... We want peace, at the cost of blood, but peace. The basic plan is to simply destroy the Imperials so they can't run amok anymore, and then help the free army. After all that, we'll simply live in peace and develop until enemies come to us. If they're other Bavians, we'll simply conquer them and make peace again.

E226.title: Let's get started.
E226.description1: Bagor is already well-developed, but that's not enough. So we're continuing to build up the city. It's been decided to build additional residential areas in its outlying areas, and to construct factories and manufacturing plants where the old buildings are no longer needed. After that, we'll begin developing the countryside.

E225.title: Clear.
E225.description1: Unlike many cities in central Bavia, Bagor has already implemented electrification, allowing us to focus more attention on factories and plants. Industrialization will continue in the capital, but the countryside will also be affected.

E220.title: Hooray!
E220.description1: The Free Army in the East shares our views, but the problem with unification is that we can't choose the leader of the future state. War isn't our approach, so what can we do? We'll launch small operations to increase our influence, and once we achieve the necessary influence, we can unite under our leadership.

E69.title: Hooray!
E69.description1: Blue Column terrorists have risen from under our boots. They've started a large-scale mutiny in the army, seizing the southern part of our country. It's time for us to destroy them and unite the empire! (Events will continue in 1848!)

E224.title: Fine.
E224.description1: Predictably enough, the Blue Column accepted our request for an alliance. Now we'll defend each other, and this also gives us a guaranteed opportunity to unite, but for now we need to think about ourselves. We have some promising development plans, so it's time to implement them.

E89.title: Let's remain neutral (More answers to come)
E89.description1: Lirnornius emerged and began his speech: "Dear citizens of the Southern Socialist Republic of Bavia, I am glad that after almost 20 years we live in peace and tranquility. I am ready to officially announce that I will remain in the position of Commander-in-Chief, which will now be called General-in-Chief. I want to thank all our soldiers; they are the bravest and strongest people I have ever seen. We, the people, the army, all of us, can reclaim our Union and our greatness! And I hope you are ready for this too; very soon we will fully rebuild the country and continue our journey!"

E221.title: It's clear.
E221.description1: There's a war going on with Ranlonia right now. A rather minor warlord has decided to resist us. So we've simply decided to conquer them. The logical and primary goal now is to destroy them, so the events will take place at the end of 1847!

E52.title: Forward!
E52.description1: We've begun the first stage of negotiations on the unification of our countries. Our diplomats have noticed some initiative on the part of the diplomats from Fonreal. Maybe it will work out after all?

E218.title: Understood.
E218.description1: After partially completing electrification, we can begin industrialization. Lenorin has a fairly robust industry, which could help us develop the entire country. It was decided to industrialize the entire country with Lenorin's help.

E109.title: Meeting in Krando.
E109.description: After completing our primary domestic concerns, we decided to go global. A meeting was organized in Krando (Enderske, Vosend Region). As a result of this meeting, the first connections between our countries were established, and the first discussions regarding our borders began.

E108.title: The Second Economic Reform.
E108.description: We were finally able to complete the most important reforms for our state. Laws related to factories and manufactories were partially amended. Now our country is ready to implement the second stage of unification.

E77.title: Clear.
E77.description1: Anti-war riots have broken out in northern Aleskan. It's time for us to suppress them or inspire the people to defend the Emperor. Which will we choose?

E214.title: It's time to destroy the madmen.
E214.description1: We've decided to create more divisions to defeat the Imperials. True, this could seriously undermine us, but why should it?

E212.title: Let's start getting ready!
E212.description: They will already attack in April.
E212.description1: In two months, we were able to quickly prepare for war against the Order. Besides our strong defense, we'll also be able to attack the Order itself after we've fought back. The main thing is to stick to the plan. After the Order's fall, we'll have many challenges ahead, but for now... Hold the Line!

E106.title: Regency.
E106.description: Recently, our general, who led the entire Order, declared himself the Holy Regent, and would remain so until all of Bavia was united. After the Empire's rise, a new monarch would be chosen, and the Regent would step down from his post. "I will preserve Bavia for the Emperor."

E213.title: We will hold on!
E213.description1: We've decided to put an end to these madmen in the local government. They've simply gone nuts, and our idea is supported by SAB, and we want to give people freedom of speech and, simply, a more peaceful life. (Events will continue in 1848!)

E105.title: The First Economic Reform.
E105.description: After we've built the Governorates, we can begin reforming the economy along new lines. The changes primarily affected the cities, primarily the capital. Furthermore, the first laws were introduced to increase the number of entrepreneurs.

E50.title: Cover up the traces.
E50.description: Maybe everything will work out on its own...
E50.description1: We're under attack! The ASR has decided to attack our ally, it's time to protect them. Let's wait and prepare!

E102.title: Which side will you play for? ( ⅠⅠ )
E102.description: It's time to choose our side in this terrible war of our people. Who will you be?

E217.title: Fine.
E217.description1: Our lands used to hold most of the reserves needed to electrify all of Bavia, but unfortunately, the BSSR didn't have time to do the necessary work. Furthermore, our lands have changed hands many times since the start of the Second Great War. So, it will be quite difficult to build a proper system, even with the reserves. We'll keep trying and hoping.

E71.title: Hooray!
E71.description1: Since such a major rebellion has occurred in our Empire, it's time for us to reform the government. The country will now be divided into provinces, and in the future, these provinces will be created into Governorates.

E103.title: Northern Order!
E103.description: Finally, after numerous trials and even military campaigns, we managed to complete the first stage of land reunification. But our administrative system and economy were simply not ready. We will need to change many things. Let nothing stand in our way!

E101.title: Which side will you play for? ( Ⅰ )
E101.description: It's time to choose our side in this terrible war of our people. Who will you be?

E207.title: It's clear.
E207.answer1: Bot | Question of the South, League.
E207.description1: No lands in the south. The League still has the necessary lands.

E68.title: Yes.
E68.description1: After three rounds of negotiations with Batvia, we were able to agree on Batvia's autonomy within our country, and finally, its full annexation! So, in addition to land, we also gained a decent industry!

E206.title: Fine.
E206.description1: After lengthy negotiations with the Order, we managed... No! One of our ambassadors was killed right at the meeting. This is simply the most horrific act against us. We immediately canceled all delegations and decided on a new plan. After all our political plans are fulfilled, we will begin terrorizing them and wait for them to decide to attack us. Revenge will be sweet!

E55.title: For the future of Bavia!
E55.description1: Recently, a raid was carried out on our lands, presumably by bandits from the "lakes." After this incident, questions arose in the country about the fulfillment of the plan established back in 1837. It seems it's time for us to take action.

E100.title: We have started a civil war.
E100.description: We've started a civil war. It's time to fight, isn't it?

E87.title: It's clear.
E87.description1: It's time for us to help our majority. We'll improve their "exit to the world," provide them with electricity, water, and food, and repay their debt for believing in us!

E81.title: Clear
E81.description1: We defeated the Republic, captured the main parts of its lands, and now they have surrendered to us!

E84.title: Forward, new Republic!
E84.description1: After such a massive expansion of our country, it's time for us to put our economy on a new track. We'll implement all the reforms, but which one will we choose first for our development?

E259.title: OK.
E259.description1: Our spending isn't enough to support our army. If you want to fix this, just change the law.

E258.title: OK.
E258.description1: We have pure capitalism. This gives various entrepreneurs the opportunity to improve our country, make us richer, and simply improve our lives.

E88.title: It's clear.
E88.description1: Finally, after lengthy trials and various actions, we live in peace. But now two men are vying for the position of ruler. Kasholov and Shchepkinov, different men with different interests and views, but they both have their eyes on the position of Ruler. We can't rock the boat we just built, right?

E257.title: OK.
E257.description1: We have a mixed economy. This gives us many opportunities to develop the country and help the people.

E256.title: Collect additional tax.
E256.description1: We have a planned economy. This gives us the advantage of focused development.

E254.title: Pure Capitalist System.
E254.description1: How much will you spend on your army? This determines the size of the army you can maintain without any problems.

E255.title: Maximum Expenses.
E255.description1: Here we can carry out some political actions that can calm the people or do something else...

E54.title: Hooray!
E54.description1: The Order of the Salvation of Bavia was founded back in 1835, almost immediately after the Second Great War. We control Fonren, the heart of Bavia. After capturing these lands, we set the most important goal of our existence: the reunification of all of Bavia. So, by 1837, we had already begun to establish relations with the world, and the largest countries had already recognized us. What next?

E94.title: Clear.
E94.description1: Tanks were found in the forests of the former Republic of Bavia! It turned out to be a factory that used to produce tanks. What luck we had, it's still operational, hurray!

E42.title: Clear
E42.description1: We have a lot of money! Inflation ⅠⅠ has arrived .

E45.title: For a great idea!
E45.description1: We've finally managed to gather the strongest people from our League. After many years, they're ready, hurray! But in addition to the great idea, we'll also have to implement it, and the ASR is too strong a stronghold; we'll destroy them later!

E90.title: Oh my god
E90.description1: It's time to fully electrify our country. We still have some remaining wiring from the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic, but it won't even cover Aleskan. We'll start building it now.

E43.title: Clear
E43.description1: We have a lot of money! Inflation has arrived .

E92.title: Fine
E92.description1: Recently, news came in of some kind of conflict on the northern borders. It turns out the enemy attempted to seize the border area, but our brave soldiers were able to repel them. This clearly shows us that there will be no peaceful resolution.

E98.title: Good.
E98.description1: After numerous provocations from the VKAB, the Holy Regent has finally decided to continue the unification of the country. Our new target will be Voston!

E53.title: Fine!
E53.description1: The second phase of negotiations with Fonreal recently took place, and we were able to achieve unification! This is a great diplomatic victory; for the first time, something happened in the territory of the former Bavia without the smell of gunpowder or the taste of lead.

E80.title: It's time to show yourself to the people...
E80.description1: We have a lot of money! Hyperinflation has arrived!

E153.title: Hard...
E153.description1: We are a lost state; after the Second Great War, we could have ceased to exist altogether... But we survived. Now we face a huge number of sanctions and problems. Trade restrictions with Endersk, a blockade from Methenia—it's tough. All the sanctions affecting us will have a severe impact on our economy, so we will have to survive.

E131.answer1: Continuing our plan to exterminate the Metbavs, we've begun using gas and simple executions. Sixty percent of the remaining houses were destroyed after the initial influx. Now there's even more room for the Metten people. Let's destroy them!

E97.title: GOYDA!
E97.description1: We are peace-loving and we don't want to fight, so neither our people nor we will fight.

E130.answer1: After the start of the second phase and the complete annexation of Metta's lands, our economy has seen a significant boost across the board. This is an economic boom for our nation. But we can't let up, and it's time to continue our plan.

E129.title: Destroy their families.
E129.description: We'll begin the master plan by destroying their people's sense of family. Now every child will be sent to correctional camps, and their parents will be enslaved, or they'll be allowed to live, temporarily...

E62.title: Yes.
E62.answer1: Establishment of the Security Economic Forum.
E62.description1: We're already looking bigger, and since we've started implementing our plan, it's time to lay the foundations of a good economy. Now we'll have the ETF to help us.

E127.title: Defeat Metta.
E127.description: After many protracted battles, we were able to break their spirit, and now they will sit before us, begging for mercy. Under the new Fotim Peace Treaty, Ordesstein will receive extensive lands, including the western part of City-Metta. In addition, our allies from Methenia will acquire territories, and a new state, Valtheria, will appear on the world map.

E76.title: Clear.
E76.description1: It's time for us to finally destroy the rebels, attack! We will break through their defenses with the help of the Empire's most loyal soldiers.

E261.title: It's clear.
E261.description1: Our spending isn't enough to support our army. If you want to fix this, just change the law.

E260.title: With Galsk!
E260.description1: Our spending isn't enough to support our army. If you want to fix this, just change the law.

E128.title: Second Phase.
E128.description: Once the plans are completed, we can begin the second phase of this plan. Our target will be the peoples of Metta and Metbava. The destruction of the Metbava is especially important. They live in our north, where our only trading point is, but why isn't there a great nation there? It's time we fix that.

E95.title: New tanks!
E95.description1: The bonuses from this old but still good factory are just wonderful, now we will always have tanks!

E104.title: Reform of the Provinces!
E104.description: Since we've become too large for peaceful governance, it's time for us to adopt the old methods. Governorates are a great help in governing the country. We now have the Batva, Fonrenovo, and Ozersk Governorates. Besides more peaceful governance, we can prepare for economic reforms.

E46.title: Clear!
E46.answer1: The problem is in the Army.
E46.description1: The army in our great league hasn't been updated for a long time. The last one was the Division League. But the problem is that our people haven't yet been initiated into the great idea, and can they be turned into honest soldiers? It's a difficult choice.

E8.title: Clear
E8.description1: Those "Barbarians" managed to take not only resources but also border lands. This time, our army was unprepared. Now, strikes against our government have broken out across the country. The situation is at its most dangerous. What will we do?

E143.title: Fine.
E143.description1: We begin the final process of exterminating other peoples. Now the great Ordenstein can continue to exist without the creatures within. The villages in Metta were essentially destroyed, and a night of death occurred in the western City of Metta.

E32.title: For the Motherland!
E32.description1: Antast stopped cooperating with us a long time ago. And now they've decided to officially end our relationship. It's simply terrible, are we losing an ally or... We're the largest army in all of Bavia, isn't it time we conquered them? We'll attack in the coming months!

E31.title: The Order shows its teeth.
E31.description1: The VKAB is an army with a country. We've been like that for a long time, but we're also the most official government of the former BSSR! But unfortunately, our country has lost, and now it's time for us to think about its unification. What's next?

E245.title: I'm buying.
E245.description1: Now, as if there is development, we need to pull you up.

E60.title: This is good.
E60.description1: As we began implementing our plan, we encountered our first major problem: Batvia. The Batvians aren't Bavians, but even before the founding of the empire, they were entirely within our country. What will we do to interact with them?

E148.title: It's clear.
E148.description1: "Our next target is those horrible people from Endelsmark!" said Hernernn. "These geniuses have decided to create a state of Barborros right on our old lands, and it's time to punish them for it! The main thing is that no one interferes with this action."

E21.title: Yes
E21.description1: With Gondritsia in ruins, we can finally calmly implement reforms. Our economy has been stagnant for too long, and it's time for change. Besides, we need to prepare for an imminent attack on our neighbors, making the choice even more difficult.

E19.title: It's clear
E19.description1: Venorion has died. He was our general and commander-in-chief of the army. Now the ASR will lead Lirnornius. "It's high time for our country to unite."

E186.title: Fine.
E186.description1: The time has come for revenge for everything Ordenstein has done. Everything he's done to us, to our people, to our humanity. He doesn't deserve to exist in this world. Forward, comrades! Forward, people! Forward, army! All for the sake of our freedom and the return of democracy!

E160.title: Sadly.
E160.description1: After visiting Galsk, we decided to partially contact Endersk to revise the agreements. Now the main points of peace related to the army were weakened, and trade between the countries was established.

E120.title: Reform in the Army.
E120.answer1: Let the original plan be the master plan.
E120.description: After successful repressions among the elite, we managed to carry out a stunning military reform. Now our most important and powerful regiments were new fighters, and all slaves were allowed into the less important army. Moreover, we now had a crucial choice for our country. Gondritsia was already up to its neck in war, so why shouldn't we simply invade it?

E180.title: Yasng
E180.description1: After two months of visiting Metenia, we managed to persuade them to make some concessions. It was decided that we would gain access to the sea, but we would not be able to claim all our old lands, and we would also have to pay port rent and war reparations. On the plus side, we also signed a non-aggression pact!

E181.title: It's clear.
E181.description1: We've done everything we need to except one thing: Mettenberg. Horrible things are happening there, murders, exterminations... It's time to put an end to this. We will begin our new course of liberating peoples. We will begin conducting guerrilla operations and carefully assist them in everything. When we are ready, we will attack!

E66.title: Attack!
E66.answer1: The first stage of negotiations with Batvia.
E66.description1: Since we've chosen the diplomatic path, it's time to finally implement it. We've begun the first stage of Batvia's peaceful unification with our country.

E12.title: Civil war.
E12.description: Our country has sunk into despair. Brother kills brother, cities burn, and the world watches in shock. "War is Hell."

E190.title: Hooray!
E190.description1: The first of our plans was administration. We have now restored the FSRB, which existed before 1823. It was from these lands that the second attack against the Imperials was launched. Now we are unifiers who will restore Bavia to its former glory. In addition to changing the flag and name, we have received official recognition from the Kingdom of Lorium and the GSDR. The districts of Voston, Antast, and Fonreal have also been created.

E222.title: Fine.
E222.description1: The Free Army of Bavia—we're part of the Southeastern Army, now based in Voston. Unfortunately, we didn't see eye to eye, and after Bavia's victory in the guerrilla war, we simply retreated to Bagor, where it turned out that some cultists had appeared just north of here who wanted to transform Bavia. We tolerated them for a long time, until we recently destroyed them.

E74.title: Hooray!
E74.description1: Let's put an end to this chaos in the east. Let's destroy them!

E30.title: Fine
E30.description1: I recently received news from the civil war in Gondritsia. Methennberg's troops, along with some from other smaller nations, were spotted there. Ordenstein has already announced the complete annexation of these lands. How the future Gondritsia will react to this is anyone's guess.

E125.title: Mobilization.
E125.description: We'll soon be implementing our plan for Metta. Since this is the case, it's time for us to begin mobilization. The goal is to quickly take the main lands and then storm City Metta. The main thing is that no one decides to start a ruckus this time.

E14.answer1: A civil war has broken out in Gondritsia following the recent assassination of the Dictator and the Lagman Crisis. Neighboring countries are already eyeing its lands.

E119.title: New plans.
E119.description: Based on our available information, it's clear to us that the situation in Gondritsia is already at breaking point. If this is about to happen, we'll invade the borderlands first, and then, when we finally have no enemy behind us, we'll head for Metta! Get everyone ready for battle!

E49.title: New union!
E49.description1: A new industrial reform was launched, the capital began to be developed, and the first questions about the economic system itself arose. What will we do?

E85.title: Development of Trade.
E85.description1: We have ports in the eastern part of the former League. So why don't we start developing them? We'll introduce new laws for merchants to make things easier for them, and we'll also improve the ports themselves. But what about communism? Yes, it changes the meaning of our principle, but what happened when we abandoned even a partial market? You should know for yourself...

E199.title: It's clear.
E199.description1: Let's begin our plan. We have three directions: Bavia, Lagmania, and the north of our country. Each of these plans plays an important role in our existence. Some issues are on the border, the issue of the islands in the northern seas, and the main direction in the north. Ultimately, we decided to resolve them all through diplomacy. Choose your direction.

E27.title: It's clear.
E27.answer2: We need to clean them all up!
E27.description1: After Lirnoriy's arrival, rumors of the leader's weakness began circulating in the government, and rumors of his overthrow are already circulating. We'll have to decide what to do with such people. Besides, they're preventing us from properly focusing on preparing for the war against the Republic.

E17.title: Negotiations on the Alliance.
E17.description1: We've had no contact with our ally, the VKAB, for a very long time. Because of this, our people have begun to lose hope. But beyond that, it's time for us to purge the government of unnecessary elements, because something is afoot in Hong Kong.

E93.title: There will be no peaceful solution...
E93.description1: Following the recent incident in the north, Commander-in-Chief Lirnorius has ordered the preparation of Plan Red Claw. According to this plan, we will attack the enemy from the north and quickly break through their defenses. After taking the capital and the remaining lands, we will complete the offensive. The war will begin in three months.

E51.title: Fine.
E51.description1: After our victory against the ASR, it's time for us to destroy the Republic as well! Since we managed to take Aleskan with our Idea, then going and destroying these unprincipled people would be the best option!

E203.title: Well... new lands.
E203.description1: We lost Severnian Island during the war against the coalition. The then-existing Republic of Great Lagmania decided to seize the archipelago for security, but now Lamgania is ablaze. Refugees from Lamgania itself are settling on Severnian lands, seeking safety. We decided to discuss the possibility of preserving the refugees living there, but with the return of the lands to us. A lengthy discussion about this is currently underway.

E202.title: OK.
E202.description1: After resolving the issues in the south, we can head west. There's still some fighting there. We're still not sure there's a single ruler there. So, it was decided to scrap the diplomatic plan and simply deploy troops to the border instead.

E201.title: OK.
E201.description1: The League is in the very south. They want to develop some great idea! But why kill people and close themselves off from the world to achieve that? Okay, our goal is Reonl. A very important city for us and our country. We tried diplomacy, but it was a failure from the start. So we decided to drop the matter.

E26.title: It's clear.
E26.description1: After acquiring new lands, it's time for us to enter the world. We'll begin developing the economy and introduce new trade laws, but who will we contact first?

E200.title: What is the League? I don't want to know either.
E200.description1: In the very south, we have an ally from Aleskan; they've already destroyed the League and are ready to contact us. We have some questions regarding the city of Reonl, located right on the border. Since we share the same ideology and the same meaning, we could try to negotiate the transfer of this city to us.

E7.title: Forward for the Empire!
E7.description1: Recently, amid wage problems and the crisis, a major riot broke out in Kurkha. Government buildings were set on fire. The opposition is gaining strength in that region, which is our main problem. What are we going to do?

E82.title: Hooray!
E82.description1: We've become too big for our economy and administration. It's time for us to reform almost all of this. It will take a long time, but otherwise we won't be able to continue to unite.

E123.title: Stop the slaves.
E123.description: During a recent military campaign, we noticed a large number of desertions from the army. These were slaves, trying to free themselves until a bullet reached them. We decided to tighten controls and penalties in the correctional camps. Now slaves will be even less likely to flee our great country.

E253.title: Actions with the country.
E253.description1: Select the law you want to adopt to ensure the operation of your economy.

E13.title: Lagman crisis.
E13.description: A civil war has been raging in Lagmania for six months now. The former second heart of the world's economy is ablaze. Initially, it didn't shake the world too much until supplies ran out... The stock market crashed in Barborrosia... and as a result, the world is sliding into a truly massive crisis.

E191.title: Fine.
E191.description1: Once we've established some industry, we can begin to fully develop it. The "Easton" plan will begin. It will lead to industrialization in many regions of the country. New ports and military factories will also be built in the capital.

E86.title: It's clear.
E86.description1: Our center in Alsekan already has a more or less normal structure, which can't be said for other cities. With the help of the center and the newly introduced systems for distributing responsibilities, we will help other cities in our country!

E197.title: It's clear.
E197.description1: After all the country's affairs are concluded, it's time for us to look at our demands. Claims to all of Bavia, lands lost in the ocean, and then there's the struggle with the Lagmans. But we need to address smaller demands, such as a portion of Bavia's lands, or the conflict with Lagmania, or rather its remnants.

E5.title: Going out to sea.
E5.description1: Another battle recently took place on the border between the League and Bavgon. These lands have been in ruins for a long time, but this time the "barbarians" were able to successfully attack several cities. Afterwards, riots broke out across the country. This particularly fueled the opposition. What should we do?
E5.description2: This may even require the involvement of the army.

E195.title: Clear.
E195.description1: We've completed all the stages: electrification is complete, trade is established, and the industrialization phase has recently concluded. Yes, we haven't become a strong world power, but we can already measure our strength against our neighbors. After this stage, we need to think about expansion. Besides the help of the people we need in Bavia, we'll also need to talk to the Lagmans...

E3.title: and once again, Hurray!
E3.description1: Welcome to my scenario, The Great New World. The story begins in 1847—the era of the new world. Many countries have become giants and empires, but some have been destroyed. This is the very first version, v0.7 (~250 events). There are many countries with events, and some interesting mechanics to spice up your gameplay.

E189.title: Hooray!
E189.description1: VICTORY! After more than five years, the east is ours! Our army marched along Antast and Fonrel, nothing will stop us. We have managed to unite all our lost lands in the east, and now we face the task of industrialization. We also have claims to several islands in the Northern Lagman Sea. But our most important goal remains the same: to reclaim the BSSR!

E173.title: Understood!
E173.description1: After three rounds of negotiations with Valtheria, we are ready for a major meeting. All the old points were discussed, as well as our unification in more detail. It was decided that we will unite at the beginning of 1851, and in the meantime, we will work to establish communication between our countries.

E146.title: Yes.
E146.description1: The Metbavs, a people who have long desired peace, are somehow not with us. Now their remnants will be annexed to our people, and their past history will be completely erased. Let the best of them, those who managed to become Mettenians, remain alive, but let them all forget their past.

E116.title: Leader of the nation.
E116.description: A great people, a great leader for the Mettens. Under Henrenn's leadership, we can build a great nation. But now let's move on to less important matters. Very soon, perhaps even this year, a civil war will begin in Gondricia. We can't let our plan slip, but for now we need to deal with the elite.

E28.title: We will help them. (Not done)
E28.description1: It's time for us to establish complete control over southern Bavia, and the only thing standing in our way is the Republic. Those bourgeois ensconced in Arnol are just trading, not even thinking about reclaiming Bavia. It's time to destroy them! (The next part of the Summer 1849 events)

E44.title: Clear
E44.description1: Our country—well, not exactly a country—is an idea. Our idea is to unite the entire world under a Great League! There may be difficulties before that, like Bavia, but we will get through it!

E122.title: It's time...
E122.description: "Since we've decided on something both insane and beautiful, then let's attack!" - Henrenn. "We will declare war on all of Gondritsia to establish the most correct order possible there."

E194.title: Fine
E194.description1: Fonren has long been considered the best port in all of Bavia. But now it's under the control of an order that claims official status. We will build "New Fonren" to develop trade and industry. From then on, Voston will be reconstructed and improved.

E193.title: Clear.
E193.description1: After the revolution, partial electrification was implemented until a new plan for national defense came into effect. But we lost, plunging into anarchy and darkness. Vostok, like several other towns, had partial power, but during the anarchy, all that was completely destroyed. It's time to re-electrify our factories and plants so they can operate properly. And let people finally get electricity in their homes.

E91.title: Clear!
E91.description1: After recent reforms, we discovered significant problems with our machine tools lagging behind global standards. So, we recently purchased some goods from Galsk for a small sum. By upgrading our machine tools, we can unite Bavia even more quickly.

E29.title: Not now.
E29.description1: We have united all of southern Bavia! Hooray! Now we are closer to uniting our entire country! Hooray!

E34.title: Destroy piracy!
E34.description1: It's time to show what a huge mistake the people from Antast made. We'll annex them, no matter what happens! Forward!

E144.title: It's clear.
E144.description1: A new history, the right history. Metta didn't exist; it was merely a splinter group from our great idea. They were seized by vile people, not even the Metta people themselves. Now we will have a new and better history for our great nation.

E140.title: Emae
E140.description1: It's time to finally develop our heavy divisions and improve our war doctrine. Most factories will now be redirected to tank production. And the new doctrine will include new tactics and the integration of slaves into the army itself.

E79.title: Hooray!
E79.description1: We have a lot of money! Inflation has arrived .

E216.title: Fine.
E216.description1: Now that we've stabilized the situation, we can consider reforms. For now, it's been decided to leave the Free Army's problems to them. In return, we'll begin industrialization. Three stages will be implemented: Electrification, Industrialization, and Provision of the People.

E4.title: Fine.
E4.description1: "The Great Economy of the Old World"—we have one of the world's best economies, ranking second in GDP—but it wasn't always that way. For most of our history, we were an insignificant feudal country, but in 1537, the New World was discovered, and we were finally able to emerge onto the world stage. True, the colonies were eventually lost, but the economic growth they generated greatly helped us. After World War I, we also gained the vital region of Kurch, and victory in World War II cemented our position as such. There are also problems, such as Methennberg, Barborossia, and others. All of them greatly hinder us, and the recent crisis caused by the civil war in Lagmania has undermined the government's popularity. What happens next depends on you.

E118.title: Great Nation.
E118.description: Our country is a reflection of a great nation. Our people are the best possible in this world. There are only a few like us, for example in the League or in Lagmania, but no one can become a true Mettenite unless they have already become one. There is only one option for such a person: to be of a higher race and to serve the Ordenstein!

E228.title: It's time to develop the country!
E228.description1: We've completed our plans for the country's development, and now we're ready to prepare our plans for influence. Very soon, we'll enter into a diplomatic battle with the Blue Column over who will lead the future unification. We plan to immediately put pressure on them for influence. Here's what we'll do.

E141.title: Fine!
E141.description1: It's time to begin our secret plans. We plan to further exterminate other nations, but... The most important thing is to create our own nuclear bomb. Having every opportunity to do so, it's time to strengthen our power and give it a chance to become unique.

E188.title: Hooray!
E188.description1: We were attacked by Metta, the pathetic peoples rebelled, but even so we were able to stand firm and now no one can stop us from being in a winning position!

E124.title: Bring back the past.
E124.description: After victory in Gondritsia, we can finally look west with peace. Metta, an insignificant country, should be incorporated into our fold. In Augustus, we will attack them along with Metenia. Our plan is to quickly reach the capital itself, and then, after taking it, force their surrender. Time to prepare!

E142.title: In honor of the Ordenstein!
E142.description1: New lands, success, and the people of Mettenberg deserve even more. It's time for us to completely destroy the opponents of our rule. Now all peoples who haven't been enslaved will be exterminated. It's time to completely destroy them!

E151.title: Something is brewing..
E151.description1: After several uprisings in the north, the slaves, with the help of their allies from Metta, have risen up and already taken key points. It's time to send an army against them and kill them!

E115.title: Who are we?
E115.description: Ordenstein Mettenberg – who are we? A state founded on an idea, or simply the ravings of a madman? We were founded in 1834 and have existed for over ten years. Until then, we were under the control of the RBG, and after a great uprising, we finally managed to gain independence. We are a dark remnant, but we also have goals: to reclaim our lands and take revenge on the RBG. But because of our isolation, we cannot develop so well; only our north has the opportunity to trade with our neighbors. It is true that our people are ready to do everything possible in our state. What will happen next?

E223.title: Mon.
E223.description1: We are quite similar to the ideas of the Blue Column, which decided to rebel against the mad imperialists. The best option now is to form an alliance, partially develop our small country, and vigorously fight for influence in the future country. Forward!

E187.title: FORWARD!!!!
E187.description1: After so many years, we managed to destroy this terrible Ordenstein, HURRAY!

E150.title: Clear.
E150.description1: Recently, a large slave revolt broke out in the north of our state, attempting to free themselves and regain their independence. We sent an army there and killed all the rebels. It's time for us to tighten our control over them even more.

E37.title: Focus on Administration
E37.description1: We've been negotiating with the Fonreal government for several months now. Ultimately, we're faced with two options: attack them or do it peacefully. The peaceful option would require lengthy negotiations, while the quicker approach would entail losses.

E25.title: It's clear.
E25.description1: Since Yuzhnotsarsk has already seen what we were able to do to Bavia, they could no longer resist after sending the ultimatum. Now these lands are ours too!

E185.title: Fine.
E185.description1: We've organized the uprising in Mettenberg, now it's time for us to help them. In two months, we'll invade Ordenstein under the pretext of protecting the peoples, and then we'll destroy it. It's time to get ready!

E20.title: Yes
E20.description1: A civil war has broken out in Gondritsia, which means they have no time for us right now. We have a very good opportunity to expand. Where will we go?

E35.title: Hooray!
E35.description1: Since we launched a strict anti-piracy campaign, ships have started arriving, but with whom should we establish good trade relations first? Much can depend on this—for example, Galsk is beneficial for construction, and Endersk for the Army.

E184.title: Fine.
E184.description1: Now the most important of the previous actions remains. It's time to organize an uprising and then help it destroy this terrible order. The first partisan groups are already ready; they will take the north of the country. And in the south, an unknown group will also be attempting to establish independence.

E149.title: Understood!
E149.description1: Although we have created a great and excellent state, a battle for the position of ruler is already raging within our ranks, among our finest generals. Slaves ready to rebel at any moment, villages destroyed, but the idea! The idea was achieved: the purest and best race. The main thing is that now we are at peace.

E211.title: Yes
E211.description1: After all the diplomatic meetings, it's time for us to choose our course. It's logical that the Order's actions against us are horrific, so we've already carried out numerous operations against them, and they're already at their limit. So war will soon begin, and we have a few months to build our defenses and then win.

E138.answer1: The Grand Army of the Ordenstein needs to be developed. With new lands and opportunities, it's time to improve it. We face two challenges: infantry and tanks. Our elite divisions, while the best in the world, still require improvement and expansion. And our tank divisions are too few; we simply need factories to build them.

E183.title: Little by little.
E183.description1: Now it's time to move on to more important matters. We've given money to the partisan units so they can begin building their outposts and survive within this dismal state. Besides helping the people, this will give us a very good position in the coming war with Mettenberg!

E11.title: Victory!
E11.description: We have been able to defeat the main evil, now only all of us remain...

E137.answer1: Now that we've calmed the slaves, we can partially expand their duties. Now, in addition to the dirty work in the fields, they will work in factories, increasing the capabilities of our great power. Furthermore, they will also serve our best soldiers and thus assist them in every way.

E113.title: The Treaty of Krando. ( ⅠⅠⅠ )
E113.answer2: We couldn't come to an agreement.
E113.description: After many lengthy negotiations with Endersk, we managed to secure the annexation of our old lands! And these are our lands from before 1826!

E178.title: Fine.
E178.description1: Looking at our past defeats, the main problem they arose from was the lack of developed science. We must not repeat our mistakes. Universities will be built in the capital, and military-technical universities will be built further afield, for defense. Our main goal is not to be weaker than Mettenberg!

E33.title: They shouldn't have done that!
E33.answer1: Piracy like in the good old days.
E33.description1: Unfortunately, our country is well known for piracy, which is why almost no one comes to our lands. It's reminiscent of our past, but that's beside the point. It's time to put an end to this!

E136.answer1: Since Metenians now reside in our special trade zone, we can increase partial turnover there. Trade with Endersk will now increase, and with Metenia's help, we can also try to influence multiple points in the world.

E73.title: Prepare! (3 turns before war)
E73.description1: Our Dynasty had numerous connections in Endersk since the days of the Empire. So why not try to lure them into investing with us? We tried, and we succeeded; now we have the opportunity to trade in the important hub of Vosend.

E112.title: The Treaty of Krando. ( ⅠⅠ )
E112.answer2: We couldn't come to an agreement.
E112.description: After many lengthy negotiations with Endersk, we managed to secure the annexation of our old lands! And these are our lands from before 1826!

E135.answer1: Having chosen a development course, we began improving our capital—the heart of a great nation. New buildings, industry, and, most importantly, the Ordensbank will be constructed. We now have great opportunities for development and even partial expansion of relations with the world.

E6.title: Clear.
E6.description1: After nearly five years, we were able to reconnect with Endersk by land. Previously, trade was hampered by Bavia's pirates and the barbarians to the south, but recently, the "Republic of Bavia," Endersk, and We were able to establish a fast route between our countries, improving our economies.

E40.title: Clear.
E40.description1: After some time, we received the first benefits from the assimilation of Fonreal.

E177.title: GOYDA
E177.description1: We haven't updated our constitution since Mettenberg's defeat. Many things have already happened that have completely transformed our country, but the constitution remains the same. It will be rewritten, and the Commander-in-Chief of the Army will be our leader only until all the problems with the Ordenstein are resolved!

E219.title: Understood.
E219.description1: Although we're not a large country, we need to prepare our administration for a larger country, and it's not yet ready for our size. We've decided to simply increase the number of regions and create separate senates for each region. So far, this system has proven very successful in testing. We're hoping for more.

E134.answer1: We'll begin our economic development plan. We need to choose what to develop and how. At least we have a well-developed north that can be used for the entire country. What should we choose?

E208.title: Yes
E208.answer1: Bot | Question of the South, ASR.
E208.description1: Lands in the south. ASR has the necessary lands.

E174.title: It's clear
E174.description1: Since we're still in the process of preparing for unification, we'll implement a unified road system. This will make things easier for us during unification. Besides this, we've also managed to carry out partial reforms in both countries, so we're getting closer to revenge!

E75.title: For the Emperor!
E75.answer1: An attempt on the Emperor's life!
E75.description1: Recently, in Northern Aleskan, one of the Blue Column terrorists attempted to assassinate our Emperor. He fired three shots, two of which missed and one to the arm. After that day, an intensified hunt for the Blue Column fighters began.

E133.answer1: It's time for us to develop our economy and the entire system that will support our great power. This plan is a composite of three additional plans, which will focus on the Army, the Economy, and Additional Factors.

E110.title: Talking about the borderland.
E110.description: After the meeting in Krando, the first goals were set, and one of them was the border. We've begun the initial discussions about it. We need to choose the goal we want to agree on.

E24.title: I'm buying.
E24.answer1: It's time to help our ally!
E24.description1: The Kingdom was attacked by some communists in the ASR, it's time to protect a friend!

E10.title: For Freedom!
E10.description: It's time for us to finally make our country free! After the dictator's assassination, no one can stop us from doing so anymore. Hooray!

E132.answer1: After a long period of clearing land in the north, we can be completely confident that no one will stand in our way of creating a great nation. Now we will begin to develop our industry and the economy itself, so that our nation will lack nothing!

E182.title: Let's begin.
E182.description1: We can easily support the people living on our border. Mettenberg hasn't yet built his great walls there, and we'll be able to feed the starving. While the Ordenstein is basking in victory, we'll start acting from the ground up. And most importantly, we'll now be able to more easily accept refugees!

E205.title: We need more...
E205.description1: It's time for us to meet with the Order. They're quite radicalized toward us, as they also want to unite Bavia. But even with this start, we decided to try our luck. We went to Fonren, where we began discussing some border issues. We'll also try to establish a more peaceful relationship.

E36.title: Let it be Endersk!
E36.description1: Since we've decided to begin uniting Bavia, it's time for us to initiate several reframings. We'll carry them all out, but we'll focus on one in particular. Besides, there are already rumors of connections in Foneral; something is brewing...

E145.title: It's clear.
E145.description1: Metta never existed; it's just a lie. They were rebels who refused to accept the true path. They resisted the real idea for a long time, but recently their minds were straightened out. Now they will be erased from the history of our state.

E61.title: Enmity.
E61.description1: It's time for us to make our first expedition to the free southern lands. The locals have been living freely and committing robberies for a long time. It's time to bring them civilization!

E22.title: It's clear.
E22.description1: It's time to begin our first campaign to unite Bavia, and our first target will be the "kingdom." The generals promise an easy victory, but only if the League doesn't intervene on behalf of the kingdom. Forward, comrades!

E175.title: Fine!
E175.description1: Very soon we will unite, and our countries are already very closely connected. A treaty of partial annexation was signed in Elysion, and they are already, so to speak, our vassal. Now all that remains is for us to become united!

E172.title: Fine.
E172.description1: It's time to start talking about unification. Our countries have fought together for a long time, and never tried to destroy each other. We aided the Walters when they were about to be exterminated, and together we became independent. But we face a new threat that has torn us apart. This time, unification will be essential for our survival. The Ordenstein are already beginning the massacre of peoples, and we are simply sitting here?! I hope you will consider my words.

E57.title: New advantages.
E57.description1: For a long time now, our neighboring territory of Bavia, with its entire former navy, has been preventing us from trading normally. They're simply blocking all ships from the Gulf and brazenly engaging in piracy. Isn't it time we punished them? Let's begin preparations right now!

E176.title: Very good.
E176.description1: EVERYTHING! We are united, finally! The last meeting in Elysion ended with the signing of a treaty of mutual assistance, which included a clause on our unification. A large and strong republic! Now we are once again the country we were, except for our old lands. No matter how terrible Mettenberg is, he will be destroyed!

E15.title: Yes...
E15.description1: We are one of the two remaining strongholds of legitimate authority in Bavia. But in Aleskan, we are not so fortunate. Just about ten years ago, all these lands were entirely under the control of Gondritsia, and only after the Partisan Operation were they ceded. Now we are a strong economic and political stronghold, so it's time for us to unite all of Bavia with our great General.

E171.title: Fine.
E171.description1: It's time to start talking about the Army. Until we become a unified state, we need to decide how we will work. We will implement a unified reform for both countries, shifting tactics to a more partisan approach. Also, from now on, our army commanders-in-chief will lead them together as one large army!

E111.title: The Treaty of Krando ( I )
E111.description: After many lengthy negotiations with Endersk, we managed to secure the annexation of our old lands! And this is the Borderland!

E179.title: Understood
E179.description1: While Methenia is a real problem for us, we can't afford to fight a war on two fronts this time. We need to try to negotiate with them about this, and also try to negotiate the possibility of partially trading through our old ports.

E147.title: It's clear.
E147.description1: Now we've reached the great legends of our state. Ordenstein has great legends; our people have long boasted great warriors who destroyed the Mettians. And the pinnacle of our history is the great battle against Gondricia. They tried to pin us down, but we fought back and grew even stronger.

E9.title: Hooray
E9.description1: "Dear fellow citizens of Greater Gondritsia, you've been demanding change for a long time, and you're wondering what's going on. But right now, we need to unite against... (gunshot)." And so ended our president's speech; he was assassinated. Almost immediately, a Congress was founded in Kurkha, and the capital descended into chaos.

E41.title: Fine.
E41.description1: We have a lot of money! Inflation Ⅰ has arrived .

E169.title: It's clear
E169.description1: We'll begin our negotiations with Valtheria and try to reach an agreement with her on uniting to counter Ordenstein and Methenia. What will we choose first for discussion in Elysion? A clear goal is for everything to proceed smoothly and without conflict...

E72.title: Clear.
E72.description1: After solving our problems, it's time for us to look east. Since we can't simply drive the communists out of Aleskan, it's time for us to grow and become stronger. Our goal will be to march east!

E23.title: It's clear.
E23.description1: It's time to begin our first campaign to unify Bavia, and our first target will be the "League." It's a fairly stronghold of something strange, and it's the only obstacle we have before meeting the VKAB! Forward!!!

E114.title: Assassination attempt on the Regent!
E114.description: Recently, when the Holy Regent arrived in Ozers, an attempt was made to assassinate him as he entered a building, and a bullet struck him in the shoulder. The assassin was caught almost at the spot where he fired, and it was later revealed that he was from the east. After this, Rgenet announced the beginning of the second stage of unification. (War will begin in April, prepare.)

E83.title: Good.
E83.description1: We've been calling ourselves Aleskan for a long time, but we control all of southern Bavia. It's time for us to disband the ASR and create the Southern Socialist Republic of Bavia. Now we'll partially shift course toward the economy and social structure; it's time to help the people!

E107.title: Explosion in Fonren.
E107.description: Recently, a building frequented by the Holy Regent was blown up in our capital. Unfortunately, there are 13 dead and 38 injured, and the suspected perpetrators have already been apprehended. Our government is beginning to suspect that this terrorist was sent from the Communist Army in the east. For now, we will await the investigation.

E38.title: We are preparing for new negotiations.
E38.description1: It's time to destroy them! With their fall, we will unite all of eastern Bavia. Since they refused to join us peacefully, traitors!

E170.title: We won't be able to contact VKAB.
E170.description1: It's time to start talking about our state's future economy. Currently, neither we nor Valtheria have access to the sea. But Valtheria has partial trade opportunities through Methenia. Since our industry is concentrated in the capital, which is now close to the borders, we can negotiate such trade. Furthermore, we will give weak rural Valtheria the opportunity to work in our factories, or rather, in their remnants.

E168.title: Fine!
E168.description1: For the third time in our history, we stand on the brink. Now, under Hekovsk's leadership, we will try to remain alive forever, at least within these borders, although it's never impossible to reclaim our lands. Our first target will be Valtheria, for which we have great plans.

E70.title: Send the Army!
E70.description1: We are the last stronghold of the lands under the control of the Aleskan dynasty. The last heirs were almost killed in the Byelorussian SSR, but they managed to escape and then go into hiding. Now our goal is to retake our city, where the communists have taken over. Well, since the Bavians have caused us so many problems, no more Bavia, only Aleskan! For the Emperor! For Kirill VII!

E16.title: Fine.
E16.description1: From the South, the dark divisions of Gondortia are constantly raiding us, and we have to survive with it, eh...

E99.title: Attack!
E99.description1: Recently, news of uprisings has reached the lands of Eastern Barborrossia. According to eyewitnesses, the region is almost completely out of Barborrosia's control. The Empire itself has yet to respond to these events.

E196.title: Hooray!
E196.description1: Before we begin our business outside the country, we need to prepare for it. With new capabilities and personnel, we will not only improve the army, but also expand it. Now we will have not one army, but several divisions at once: one in the south and two in the north. Changes have also affected the Navy. Now our ships will not intercept foreign vessels unless they pose a threat.

E243.title: I'm buying.
E243.description1: The military corporations sent us a proposal to purchase 15 artillery pieces. Will we buy them?

E121.title: We are ready!
E121.description: Finally, we will carry out the operation to annex the lands closest to us from Gondortia, it’s time to begin!

E192.title: Fine.
E192.description1: The first stage of industrialization begins: New Factories and Plants. Using the power of the capital and Fonrel, it was decided to develop not only the important Antast but also smaller towns and villages. By the end of this stage, which is roughly by the end of the plan, we will be much stronger.

E56.title: Clear.
E56.description1: Recently, the Order's President officially announced a complete shift in foreign policy toward a trade-oriented one. Our country's ports were now open to almost everyone, and we welcomed them all.

E58.title: Understood!
E58.description1: It's time we teach these Pirates a lesson, for they refuse to accept us, and therefore refuse to take back the old Bavia! Attack!

E198.title: It's clear.
E198.description1: Now it's time to begin our plans for the world. Three directions lie before us: the Bavia portion of the land, the Islands of Freedom, and the Order. We'll be implementing our plans gradually, so it's time to choose which one to do first. After all these plans are finalized, we'll begin looking more toward Bavia.

E152.title: For Ordenstein!
E152.description1: The state of Metta, or in our old dialect, Limeto. From the 13th to 15th centuries, we enjoyed a true golden age. We were invincible, but after such success, we began to crumble, and in 1749 we fell, the fall of the capital, and then our attempts to survive. During the Great War, we managed to recapture the capital and grow considerably, until we lost to Endersk and Gondritsia in the Second Great War. That's how we found ourselves in such a dire situation. The vast border with Metta is a huge problem, and on top of that, the Empire of Endersk and Gondritsia imposed sanctions on us. There's intense pressure from Barborossia and danger from Metenia. Many problems, but we survive...

E167.title: For protection!
E167.description1: After a devastating defeat, it's time for us to consolidate all our industrial capabilities into City Metta. This scheme will allow us to evenly improve and expand industry across the country. It will also give us a better chance of not losing it to Endersk.

E166.title: Understood!
E166.description1: Our first priority is to reform the army. We will no longer comply with the demands of some Endersk; our primary goal is to survive! Through blood and sweat, but we will survive! A brutal industrialization will begin on the remnants of our land. Furthermore, corps will be created to defend the capital from Mettenberg!

E117.title: Question of the Elite.
E117.answer1: We don't need a repeat of 1842...
E117.description: Our great leader Henren has long distrusted his best soldiers. After an incident in 1842, when some of them attempted to overthrow the regime, a brutal repression was carried out. But this wasn't enough for the Leader. It's time we began testing all our best soldiers.

E96.title: Hooray for tanks!
E96.description1: It's time to implement our plan and, at the same time, continue to unite our Union. Forward, comrades! Let's put an end to these bandits! Hurray!!!

E67.title: Yes.
E67.answer1: The second stage of negotiations with Batvia.
E67.description1: We have begun the second stage of Batvia's peaceful unification with our country. And we have already begun negotiations on autonomy and a joint alliance. We are closer to unification!

E63.title: Hooray.
E63.description1: Now we will completely annex the lands of this country of pre-anarchy. We are growing bigger and bigger!

E165.title: Mon.
E165.description1: We've lost again, over and over again. It seems like this will always be the case, but maybe we should try again...? Hekovsk, our army commander-in-chief, will take over as president. While we're recovering, we'll have a lot of problems to deal with. Besides, Valtheria is now located to the south, right next to our capital...

E157.title: Hooray! Right?
E157.description1: Our president decided to personally come to Metenia for extensive talks on trade and other issues. Following this meeting, we were able to agree on a partial end to the conflict at sea, as well as on greatly open trade between our countries. Now we can trade more effectively across the sea, and therefore develop ourselves more effectively.

E59.title: Hooray!
E59.description1: After taking their capital, Generon, they finally surrendered to us, now all their lands are ours, as is the fleet!

E39.title: Not now.
E39.description1: Since Fonreal has fallen, it's time for us to assimilate these lands. It won't be a pleasant process, but it will bring significant benefits in the future.

E47.title: Everyone!
E47.description1: The situation in Gondritsia is dire right now, and since we have the chance, why don't we go and plunder their lands? They're already too weak anyway, and their Division is practically useless next to us. So, attack!

E164.title: Hard...
E164.description1: We managed to contact the Mettenberg government, and we decided to sign a peace treaty so that our country could at least survive. Now we've lost approximately 80% of our land, and we're still without a new president.

E204.title: Clear.
E204.description1: After months of negotiations with the Salvation Government of Lagmania, we managed to agree to transfer the territories to us, but... The refugees remain on these lands and can come to us without any problems. In addition, we are also establishing economic and trade ties with the Salvation Government. For us, this is one of the best possible outcomes of the negotiations. But among our generals, there are those who want more, which means war. What will we choose?

E64.title: Yes.
E64.description1: It's time we prepared for the march on Batvia. Surely some pathetic republic can stop us from uniting Bavia? So what's the matter? In three months, we'll be on the attack!

E163.title: Hard...
E163.description1: Fengon is dead, which means we're left without a ruler. What are we going to do? The deliberations have been long, and the people have already taken matters into their own hands. Lawlessness is rampant throughout the country. Murders, thefts, civilian clashes, and all this in the capital itself! It looks like this is the end...

E156.title: Free time.
E156.description1: The first thing Fengon (our president) decided to do was reform the economy. Our country's industrial sector had been stagnant for a long time, and the recent crisis completely destroyed it. Now, under the new plan, factories will be purchased from Galsk and Barborrosia. This will also expand opportunities for entrepreneurs and traders. Most importantly, the first attempt at contacting the Metenian government has also been made.

E139.answer1: In addition to our most elite soldiers, it is time to increase the less-reinforced army. The "Millitro" divisions will be created to protect the borders, and they will also include slaves who will be selected from all over the country.

E18.title: Yes.
E18.description1: Recently, during training, our army accidentally reached Yuzhnotsarsk, thinking it was Aleskan. A skirmish ensued, in which we won and were able to reclaim some of the land.
